title: Recovering Irreducible Three-Body Interactions with Lagrangian Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.13292v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Lagrangian Neural Networks (LNNs) learn mechanical systems from trajectory data by parameterizing a scalar Lagrangian and deriving the dynamics through the Euler-Lagrange equations, biasing the model toward motion that respects the variational structure of mechanics. The interactions studied so far have been pairwise-additive, leaving open whether LNNs can recover an irreducible many-body interaction from motion alone. We address this using the Axilrod-Teller triple-dipole interaction, the leading three-body dispersion term, whose dependence on the collective geometry of three particles cannot be represented by any sum of pairwise terms. We prescribe the kinetic energy exactly and learn only the potential, as a function of interparticle distances and angles. translated_title: 使用拉格朗日神经网络恢复不可约三体相互作用
translated_abstract: 拉格朗日神经网络（LNNs）通过参数化一个标量拉格朗日量并经由欧拉-拉格朗日方程推导动力学，从轨迹数据中学习力学系统，使模型偏向遵循力学变分结构的运动。迄今为止所研究的相互作用均为成对可加形式，尚不清楚LNN能否仅凭运动本身恢复不可约的多体相互作用。我们采用Axilrod-Teller三偶极相互作用——即主要的三体色散项——来解决这个问题，该相互作用对三个粒子集体几何构型的依赖无法用任何成对项之和来表示。我们精确规定动能，仅学习势能，将其表示为粒子间距离和角度的函数。结合一种信号感知的采样策略，将训练数据集中在三体信号最强的区域，同时保持对构型空间的广泛覆盖，该方法……
tldr: 本文通过拉格朗日神经网络精确学习势能函数，并结合信号感知采样策略，首次证明仅从轨迹数据即可恢复无法用成对项之和表示的不可约三体相互作用（Axilrod-Teller三偶极相互作用）。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that Lagrangian Neural Networks, by learning the potential energy from interparticle distances and angles combined with a signal-aware sampling strategy, can recover irreducible three-body interactions (the Axilrod-Teller triple-dipole term) from trajectory data alone.
